subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Should this Control UI progress strip be implemented only after the broader gateway-owned session activity contract is approved, or should a smaller UI-only phase strip ship first using existing coarse session/tool signals?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent phase taxonomy and source of truth affect gateway protocol, session state, reconnect recovery, and UI semantics; automation should not choose that product/API boundary alone.

options.title: Use gateway activity contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Control UI consumer while maintainers settle the per-session activity API in the canonical gateway issue.

options.title: Ship a UI-only interim strip
options.body: Allow a narrower Control UI change to show coarse existing signals now, accepting that it may later be replaced by the gateway contract.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Decline a first-class progress surface and keep only the existing in-progress/done/interrupted composer indicators.

recommendation.title: Use gateway activity contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Control UI consumer while maintainers settle the per-session activity API in the canonical gateway issue.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical gateway activity issue and appears in current-path blame/history for the coarse status surface.
